about: T-509: the tarot decks in both books, the GBA's half. THE SUBTLE LAYER opens on its cover with the deck tile beside it; DOWN lights it, A expands the CARDS section; THE CARD OF THE DAY turns (the companion's cardOfDay for this save's trainer and today) and opens its words; A SINGLE DRAW from The Deck of Instinct (selector, shuffle, the spread, a card lifted, pulled, landed, turned, read); PAST / PRESENT / FUTURE from A Combined Deck, three placed and turned; B collapses the section. Then THE HERMETIC LAYER at night: its day's card and its selector, as The Deck Above, so The Deck Below, or Both as One; and at DEBUG's 3:30 AM the thin half-hour's Within / Without. Uses the theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.
